examples.text: Hij retoucheerde de foto om de kleuren bij te stellen.

glosses: To improve something (especially a photograph), by adding or correcting details, or by removing flaws.
To colour the roots of hair to match hair previously coloured.
To modify a flint tool by making secondary flaking along the cutting edge.
To make slight corrections or adjustments to; to fill in or perfect.

examples.text: Use a small brush to touch up the paint anywhere it is uneven.

glosses: To fondle or to grope someone, usually in an inappropriate way.

examples.text: The creep was trying to touch up my girlfriend.

I think you remember him! He made me go into the back of his shop and he touched me up, do you remember? And afterwards we shared out the money from the Cinzano. In the end he got round to doing something disgusting, that guy, something disgusting, quite disgusting.
Ne touchez plus à cela ; si vous y retouchez, vous serez puni.
Il a retouché à cet ouvrage, à ce tableau.
Votre poème est tout à fait au point, il n’y faut plus retoucher.
Il a retouché plusieurs scènes de sa comédie.
